_help: Your search settings. `artemis setup` fills this in by interviewing you; edit by hand any time. Lives in profile/knowledge.json (gitignored). Keys starting with _ are notes.

candidate.name: [ASK]
candidate.headline: [ASK] e.g. Senior Backend Engineer, 8 years, payments and data platforms
candidate.work_authorisation: [ASK] e.g. EU citizen; needs visa sponsorship for the US
candidate.employment_status: [ASK] employed (search is confidential) | between roles | notice period until <date>
candidate.country_pack: [ASK] ISO code of the country you're employed or taxed in, for offer maths (data/countries/<CODE>.md)

target_titles: [ASK] 3–8 market titles, e.g. Senior Backend Engineer
search_criteria.target_levels: [ASK] the level(s) you want, and whether one step down is acceptable
upside_signals: [ASK] what makes a role exciting for you, e.g. strong engineering culture, equity, AI-native product

comp.numbers: Kept out of git in profile/comp.local.json: current base, bonus, floor, target.

filters._help: Regexes the scanners use (case-insensitive). Setup writes them from your target titles and location rules; you don't need to touch them.

rubric._help: Weights for the 100-point fit score. Change them if something matters more to you.

constraints.timeline: [ASK] when can you start; notice period
constraints.non_solicit: [ASK] none | e.g. no recruiting former colleagues for 12 months
constraints.confidentiality: Resumes describe scope, outcomes and methods; no non-public customer names, incident details or financials.
constraints.exit_narrative: [ASK] one neutral, forward-looking line for 'why are you leaving?'
constraints.connectors: Never use an employer's email or calendar. Check which account a connector is on before reading anything.
